1.text: Ndi umuntu wabonye umubabaro,Yankubise inkoni y'uburakari bwe.

2.text: Yaranshoreye ancisha mu mwijima,Atari mu mucyo.

3.text: Ni ukuri yakomeje kumbangurira ukuboko hato na hato,Burinda bwira.

4.text: Inyama yanjye n'umubiri wanjye bishajishijwe na we,Amagufwa yanjye yarayamenaguye.

7.text: Yankubiye mu nkike kugira ngo ntahinguka mu irembo,Yatumye umunyururu wanjye undemerera.

8.text: Ni ukuri iyo mutakiye mutabaza,Gusenga kwanjye aguheza hanze.

9.text: Inzira zanjye yazīcishije inkike z'amabuye,Aho nanyuraga yarahagoretse.

11.text: Yayobeje inzira zanjye,Kandi yarantanyaguye angira indushyi.

13.text: Yatumye imyambi yo mu kirimba cye impinguranya impyiko,

14.text: Nahindutse urw'amenyo mu bwoko bwanjye bwose,Bangize indirimbo umunsi wose.

17.text: Kandi watandukanije ubugingo bwanjye,N'amahoro akamba kure,Guhirwa narakwibagiwe.

18.text: Maze ndavuga nti“Imbaraga zanjye no kwiringira kwanjye nari mfite ku Uwiteka, birashize.”

19.text: Ibuka umubabaro wanjye n'amakuba yanjye,Apusinto n'indurwe.

21.text: Iki ni cyo nibuka,Ni byo bindema umutima.

22.text: Imbabazi z'Uwiteka ni zo zituma tudashiraho,Kuko ibambe rye ritabura.

23.text: Zihora zunguka uko bukeye,Umurava wawe ni munini.

24.text: Umutima wanjye uravuga uti“Uwiteka ni we mugabane wanjye,Ni cyo gituma nzajya mwiringira.”

26.text: Ni byiza ko umuntu yiringira,Ategereje agakiza k'Uwiteka atuje.

28.text: Yicare yiherereye kandi yihoreye,Kuko Imana yabimushyizeho.

29.text: Nakubite akanwa ke mu mukungugu,Niba hariho ibyiringiro.

31.text: Kuko Uwiteka atazagira ubwo areka umuntu iteka.

32.text: Naho yababaza umuntu ariko azamugirira ibambe,Nk'uko imbabazi ze nyinshi zingana.

33.text: Kuko atanezezwa no kubabaza abantu,Cyangwa kubatera agahinda.

34.text: Umwami ntakunda ko banyukanyukira imbohe zose zo mu isi,

35.text: Cyangwa ko bacira umuntu urubanza,Imbere y'Isumbabyose barwirengagiza.

37.text: Ni nde wahanura bikabaho,Kandi Umwami atari we ubitegetse?

38.text: Mbese ku bushake bw'Isumbabyose,Ntihaturuka ibibi n'ibyiza?

39.text: Umuntu ukiriho uhaniwe ibyaha bye,Yakwinubira iki se?

40.text: Dutekereze inzira zacu tuzigenzure,Tubone kugarukira Uwiteka.

41.text: Twerekeze imitima yacu ku Mana iri mu ijuru,Tuyitegere n'amaboko yacu.

44.text: Wikingiye igicu,Kugira ngo gusenga kwacu kudahita ngo kukugereho.

47.text: Ubwoba n'urwobo, gusenya no kurimbuka,Byose byatugezeho.”

48.text: Ijisho ryanjye riratembamo imigezi y'amazi,Ndizwa no kurimbuka k'umukobwa w'ubwoko bwanjye.

49.text: Ijisho ryanjye ntirihwema gutembamo amarira ubutitsa,

50.text: Kugeza igihe Uwiteka azitegereza,Akareba hasi ari mu ijuru.

51.text: Amarira y'ijisho ryanjye yandembeje,Mbitewe n'abakobwa bose bo mu murwa wanjye.

53.text: Banyiciye ubugingo mu rwobo rw'inzu y'imbohe,Bambirinduriraho ibuye.

54.text: Amazi yarandengeye ku mutwe,Maze ndavuga nti “Ndapfuye.”

55.text: Natakiye izina ryawe, Uwiteka,Ndi mu rwobo rw'imbohe rw'ikuzimu.

56.text: Wumviye ijwi ryanjye, ntunyime ugutwi kwawe,Ngo utumva kuniha kwanjye no gutaka kwanjye.

58.text: Ayii, Mwami,Wamburaniye urubanza rw'umutima wanjye,Wacunguye ubugingo bwanjye!

59.text: Ayii, Uwiteka,Wabonye akarengane kanjye,None ncira urubanza.

60.text: Wabonye guhōra kwabo kose,N'imigambi yabo yose bangīra.

61.text: Wumvise ibitutsi byabo, ayii Uwiteka,N'imigambi yabo yose bangīra,

62.text: N'iminwa y'abahagurutswa no kuntera,N'inama zabo zose bangīra umunsi ukira.

63.text: Itegereze imyicarire yabo,Reba imihagurukire yabo,Bangize indirimbo.

64.text: Ayii, Uwiteka,Uzabiture ibihwanye n'imirimo y'amaboko yabo!

66.text: Uzabakurikirane ufite uburakari,Kandi ubarimbure ngo bashire munsi y'ijuru ry'Uwiteka.
